id.instruksi: Dengarkan keadaan cuacanya, lalu sentuh benda yang cocok.
id.t-cerah1: Langit cerah, matahari terik. Robot mau lari-larian. Mana yang dipakai?
id.t-hujan1: Langit gelap, hujan turun. Mana yang dipakai?
id.t-cerah2: Matahari bersinar terang. Robot mau main bola. Mana yang dipakai?
id.t-hujan2: Tetes hujan jatuh dari langit. Mana yang dipakai?
id.t-angin: Angin bertiup pelan dan stabil di lapangan. Mana yang bisa dimainkan?
id.t-cerah3: Siang hari panas sekali. Robot mau main kejar-kejaran. Mana yang dipakai?
id.t-cerah4: Tidak ada awan, matahari di atas kepala. Robot mau main di lapangan. Mana yang dipakai di kepala?
id.t-hujan3: Hujan deras, jalanan jadi basah. Mana yang dipakai?
id.t-hujan4: Gerimis turun rintik-rintik. Mana yang dipakai?
id.t-hujan5: Tik-tik-tik, bunyi hujan di atap. Mana yang dipakai?
id.t-angin2: Ada angin sepoi-sepoi di lapangan yang luas. Mana yang bisa dimainkan?

en.instruksi: Listen to the weather description, then tap the item that fits.
en.t-cerah1: Sunny sky, the sun is hot. Robot wants to run around. Which one do we use?
en.t-hujan1: Dark sky, the rain is falling. Which one do we use?
en.t-cerah2: The sun is shining bright. Robot wants to play ball. Which one do we use?
en.t-hujan2: Raindrops are falling from the sky. Which one do we use?
en.t-angin: A steady breeze blows across the field. Which item can you play with?
en.t-cerah3: It is very hot at noon. Robot wants to play tag. Which one do we use?
en.t-cerah4: No clouds, the sun is overhead. Robot wants to play in the field. Which one goes on the head?
en.t-hujan3: Heavy rain, the road is wet. Which one do we use?
en.t-hujan4: A light drizzle is falling. Which one do we use?
en.t-hujan5: Pitter-patter, rain on the roof. Which one do we use?
en.t-angin2: There is a gentle breeze in the open field. Which item can you play with?

itemCount.keterangan: jumlah pilihan: 2 (payung, topi) → 3 (tambah layang-layang untuk langit berangin)
